hooks.prompt: Review the conversation and identify any tasks the user explicitly requested. Distinguish between: (1) incomplete actionable tasks — work the user asked to be done that has not been done yet; and (2) standing constraints or preferences — instructions like 'do not commit until I say so', 'always ask before pushing', 'from now on do X' — these are active rules, not tasks to complete, and should NOT be treated as incomplete. If there are incomplete actionable tasks, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "<what remains>"}. Otherwise respond with {"ok": true}.
